efficacy_outcome: Across 10 trials (544 participants), vitamin D significantly reduced fasting glucose (SMD −0.22; 95% CI −0.39 to −0.04), insulin (−0.68; −1.22 to −0.14), and HOMA-IR (−1.32; −2.30 to −0.34). ALT and TAG reductions were not statistically significant; pooled effects did not support benefit for AST, TC, HDL-C, or LDL-C.
